alice: FYI PR #14821 is blocked by CI — failing one test intermittently on macos-latest (runtime-kv snapshot mismatch). can someone with mac runners take a quick look? :eyes:
ci-bot: CI: PR #14821 — macos-latest failed (tests/test_runtime_kv.py::test_snapshot_consistency)
ci-bot: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/14821 (logs + rerun buttons)
ben: can you paste the failing snippet? might be a harmless ordering diff but we should check before updating snapshots
alice: pasted the relevant lines from the mac job log:
```
E   AssertionError: Snapshot mismatch
- expected: {"keys": ["a","b"]}
+ actual:   {"keys": ["b","a"]}
----------------------------- Captured stdout -----------------------------
INFO: kv init took 12ms
```

dana: looks like nondeterministic key ordering in test fixture. before updating snapshot, try a targeted rerun for that single test on mac to see if it's flaky or consistent. use the rerun button or run:
```
/ci rerun --job macos-latest --test tests/test_runtime_kv.py::test_snapshot_consistency
```
eric: agree with dana. also we should avoid snapshot updates unless the behavior intentionally changed. can someone repro locally on an M1? i can try later if no volunteers
alice: i couldn't repro on my intel macbook — passed locally. no M1 available here. @ben do you have access to mac runners?
ben: i can kick a targeted rerun now. i'll do it and report back. :coffee:
ci-bot: Rerun started (targeted): macos-latest — tests/test_runtime_kv.py::test_snapshot_consistency
ben: rerun finished — PASS on macos-latest. looks flaky. recommending a rerun + merge if green across other jobs. :+1:
ci-bot: Current status: PR #14821 — all checks passing after targeted rerun.
dana: if it's flaky we should add a small test change to make ordering deterministic (sort keys in fixture) or add an unstable marker and create a follow-up ticket to harden. don't just update snapshot.
alice: agree — i'll open a tiny follow-up PR to sort the keys in the fixture. for this PR, can someone approve so we can merge while the follow-up is small?
ben: approving now. :shipit:
eric: approving as well, but please file the follow-up and link it in the PR before merge (so we don't lose it).
alice: done — added follow-up issue #322 (link: https://issues.redwood.ai/322) and pushed. merging now. thanks all! :tada:
